description.attack: XML External Entity (XXE): entity eksternal SYSTEM/PUBLIC di body XML untuk membaca file/SSRF.
description.impact: Pembacaan file server, SSRF, kadang RCE.
description.detects: `<!ENTITY` + entity EKSTERNAL (SYSTEM/PUBLIC + skema fetchable) di body request.
